labels: SCRIPT_DEPENDENT: at most one supporting material script, or edge concentration >= 0.75 in a script with share < 0.25 and edge_ex_top_script <= 0
survivability.stance: SUPPORTS if conditional edge >= +band; OPPOSES if <= -band; NEUTRAL otherwise; IMMATERIAL below the material share
survivability.weighted_support_share: sum of SUPPORTS material shares / sum of material shares
